Subject: Intro + discovery recap: Redwood + Acme Analytics

Hi Laura and Bob —

Great to meet you both today. Quick recap from our call so we have shared next steps: 

- What we heard from Acme: low-latency re-ranking on production queries (~200 qps peak, median request latency target 150ms), existing embeddings pipeline in GCP, strict data residency needs for audit logs.
- Redwood fit: hosted API for early integration, then Dedicated pool for production throughput + VPC option for audit/log forwarding.
- Success criteria you mentioned: 25% token-cost reduction vs current infra, 99.5% availability during business hours, and retention of full request logs for 90 days.

Next steps I proposed on the call: 
1) I’ll send a 1-page technical summary + a draft pricing proposal by EOD Tuesday.
2) Dev will scope a short PoC plan (2–3 days of integration work, sample dataset).
3) Laura/Bob to confirm timeline and procurement contacts so we can sketch a mutual action plan.

Attachments: discovery notes (redwood-discovery-notes.pdf).

If I missed anything, flag it — otherwise I’ll follow up with the proposal tomorrow.

Thanks,

—Priya Natarajan
